entities.summary: Byodo-ji is a Koyasan Shingon temple in Anan, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. Temple # 22 on the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage. The main image is of Yakushi Nyorai. It is designated as Anan Muroto Historical Cultural Road.
